name: OpenCode History
body: A **`history_search` tool** that lets agents search earlier OpenCode sessions by keyword (**SQLite FTS5**, BM25): what the user asked, what the agent answered, and session summaries. Each result can be **opened in full**.
A short **recent-work block** for each new session, quoting the project's latest sessions. It is built once and then frozen, so the model's **prompt cache** stays valid.
Reads OpenCode's own database **read-only**, with a rebuildable index beside it: **no model calls**, no copied transcripts and no background services.
